notes.title: A Plague Tale: Requiem’s Performance Mode is live!
notes.content:
We're so thrilled to announce the release of a new patch for A Plague Tale: Requiem, bringing [b]a Performance Mode that includes additional options to optimize the graphical performance[/b] for you to enjoy Amicia and Hugo's adventure the way you prefer!

Today’s new patch adds [b]options for PC players[/b], allowing them to optimize the game’s graphical performance. The game also received several bug fixes.

[h3]Patch Notes[/h3]
•	Added options on PC to save CPU usage and gain performance on minimal configurations:
[list][*] Adjustment of the number of animated rats displayed on the screen to reduce CPU usage.
[*] Adjusting the refresh rate of the rats on the screen to reduce CPU usage.
[*] Adjust the refresh rate of the characters to reduce CPU usage.[/list]
Watch our [b]Accolades Trailer[/b] now for a flash of A Plague Tale: Requiem’s achievements and continued efforts to improve the experience!
[previewyoutube=zoEwC2TxiMA;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you all for your ongoing support support, and have fun![img

notes.title: A Plague Tale Requiem patch adds ray tracing, but only for shadows
notes.content:
A Plague Tale Requiem updates have landed, and you can now use ray tracing to enhance the horror stealth game's murky shadows. While Asobo Studio's gothic adventure already looks the part, the tech could serve as a reason to revisit the 2022 sequel, especially if you've just picked up a new graphics card like the Nvidia RTX 4070 Ti.

notes.title: Update 1.03 - Patch Notes (09/11/22)
notes.content:
[h3]Changes & Updates [/h3]
[list][*] The game is now compatible with Steam Deck[/list]
